eventMetadata.context_description: Traders have converged on 27°C as the near-certain maximum temperature for Istanbul on August 2, with market-implied odds exceeding 96 percent. This positioning reflects consensus from numerical weather prediction models and surface observations indicating stable high-pressure conditions, limited moisture advection, and modest daytime heating under partly cloudy skies. Official meteorological guidance shows daily maxima aligning closely with the long-term early-August climatology of 28–29 °C, tempered by a slightly cooler marine influence from the Bosphorus and recent model runs that have held the forecast steady. The 28 °C outcome retains only modest residual probability, while outcomes above 30 °C or below 26 °C remain negligible. A late-day surge in insolation or an unexpected shift in the 850 hPa temperature field could still push readings to 28 °C, but current ensemble spread and verification against nearby stations make such revisions unlikely before the observation window closes.
